fee_notes: Royalty Fee: 5% of Gross Revenue, payable biweekly. Hello Garage Brand Fund Contribution: 2% of Gross Revenue (capped at 3%), payable biweekly; may be increased with 30 days notice. Minimum Local Advertising Spend Requirement: 8% of Gross Revenue (not a fee paid to franchisor, but a required local spend). National Appointment Center Fee: 1% of Gross Revenue, payable biweekly (capped at 2%). Software License Fee: $99/month per GarageView license + $150/month CRM + $11/month per email address. Technology Fee: currently not charged; if implemented, $300/month (max 15% annual increase). Inside Sales Program Fee: currently not charged; if implemented, capped at 2% of Gross Revenue from transferred proposals. Transfer Fee: $10,000. Renewal Fee: $15,000. Non-Compliance Fee: up to $1,000 per occurrence. Royalty Fee Catch-Up and Brand Fund Contribution Catch-Up apply if Minimum Performance Requirement is not met.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fee | 5% of Gross Revenue | Payable biweekly | (See Note 4)
Hello Garage Brand Fund Contribution | 2% of Gross Revenue | Payable biweekly with the Royalty Fee | (See Notes 3 and 4)
Software License Fee | $99 per GarageView license, $150 for CRM, and $11 per email address. | Payable monthly | (See Note 5)
Minimum Local Advertising Spend Requirement | 8% of Gross Revenue | When incurred | (See Note 6)
National Appointment Center | 1% of Gross Revenue | Payable biweekly with the Royalty Fee | You must pay us 1% of Gross Revenue per Protected Territory (See Note 7)
Advertising Material Fee | Will vary under circumstances | When incurred | If you order any advertising materials from us, we reserve the right to charge you a fee which will vary based on the materials purchase, plus any shipping expenses we incur. We may increase the fee upon 90 days' notice to you; however, we will not increase the fee more than 20% per year.
Inside Sales Program Fee | Currently not charged | Payable monthly | We may charge an Inside Sales Program Fee upon 90 days' notice to you (See Note 8)
Transfer Fee | $10,000 | Before completion of transfer | Paid when Franchise Agreement, assets, or interest in you is transferred. You are responsible for any broker fees.
Renewal Fee | $15,000 | At least 30 days before renewal of Franchise Agreement | Paid when you renew the Franchise Agreement.
Non-Compliance Fee | Up to $1,000 per occurrence | When incurred | (See Note 9)
Technology Fee | Currently not charged | Payable monthly | We may charge a Technology Fee upon 90 days' notice to you. If we implement a Technology Fee, the fee will be $300 per month. We may increase the fee upon 30 days' notice to you; however, we will not increase the fee more than 15% annually.
